compat.legacyModuleActive: Disable the old "Foundry Mobile Bridge" module (foundry-mobile-bridge): Bag of Worlds replaces it, and running both duplicates the movement grid.
compat.appNewerThanBridge: {player} connected with app {appVersion}; this bridge is {bridgeVersion} — update the Bag of Worlds module.

enabled.name: Show movement grid
enabled.hint: Highlight the grid spaces the selected token can reach.

maxMultiplier.name: Search range (speed multiple)
maxMultiplier.hint: How far beyond the token's speed the search extends. 2 covers a dash.

colorNormal.name: Normal movement colour
colorNormal.hint: Fill colour for spaces reachable within the token's speed.

colorDash.name: Dash colour
colorDash.hint: Fill colour for spaces that can only be reached by dashing.

alpha.name: Highlight opacity
alpha.hint: Opacity of the highlighted grid spaces.

tokensBlock.name: Tokens block movement
tokensBlock.hint: Which other tokens count as obstacles when the grid is computed.

choices.hostile: Only tokens of an opposing disposition
choices.elevationruler: Follow Elevation Ruler (its rules and difficulty multipliers)

useHistory.name: Account for movement already spent
useHistory.hint: During combat, subtract the distance the token has already moved this turn.

terrain.name: Terrain cost
terrain.hint: Resolving terrain for every step is accurate but slow. Automatic skips it on scenes with no active region behaviours.

clickToMove.name: Click to move
clickToMove.hint: Clicking a highlighted space moves the token there along the computed path.

confirmDash.name: Confirm dash moves
confirmDash.hint: Require a second click before moving into a space that costs more than the token's speed.

maxCells.name: Maximum grid spaces searched
maxCells.hint: Safety cap for very fast tokens on very large scenes.

toggle.name: Toggle movement grid
toggle.hint: Show or hide the movement grid for the selected token.

notifications.occupied: That space is occupied by another token.
